subtitle: Lesson 31 · Joining Tables

eyebrow: One question decides most of it

code:
-- "Every customer, including those who've
-- never ordered, shown as $0"
SELECT per.FirstName, per.LastName, soh.TotalDue
FROM Person.Person AS per
LEFT JOIN Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS soh
    ON per.BusinessEntityID = soh.CustomerID;
caption: "Including customers who never ordered" = keep unmatched left rows = LEFT JOIN.

subtitle: Once tables are combined, the next question is almost always "now summarize it."
